title: Coral and the Orchard
author: K. M. Iversen
blurb: Rafael Vane, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
